title: MatcherPayload
description: The payload inside the signed matcher data file (crates/matcher/src/signed.rs). On disk it is canonical CBOR inside an Ed25519-signed envelope; this schema describes the payload's logical shape, which is also what crates/matcher/data/matcher-data.json holds as the editable source. Unknown fields pass through verification and are kept.

matcher_data.description: Monotonic data version. Raised on every change, never reused. A loader refuses a version below the newest it has loaded or been told about.

published.description: A date label for people; not compared.

map.description: One character (as a one-character string) to its Latin lookalike.

folds.description: Sequence folds applied in order after the map, such as ["rn", "m"].
